description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation.ex, channels/api.ex; engine/history/delivery.ex and existing history consumers only as needed
Retain DeliveryConfirmation module and record_delivery_confirmation Engine event. Executor returns normalized receipts; existing API reports them once. Extend reporter for multiple receipts, per-message body/thread/delivered attachment evidence and content-free copies. Preserve Engine ownership, edit semantics, observations, no resend after bookkeeping failure. Do not import old confirmation rename or selection-failure notice route.

Tests to add before implementation: Multiple confirmed messages, partial/unconfirmed outcomes, edit updates without duplicate history, provider attachment evidence, no source handles used as provider locators, unavailable Engine keeps transport success, notification callback/final-ID cardinality.

Branches/paths validated: Multiple confirmed messages, partial/unconfirmed outcomes, edit updates without duplicate history, provider attachment evidence, no source handles used as provider locators, unavailable Engine keeps transport success, notification callback/final-ID cardinality.

Action reuse assessment: Extend DeliveryConfirmation.record and existing Engine handler/history functions. Reuse NodeRouter/Event boundary; no second persistence or confirmation route.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.
